results.description:
When the Sweet family’s Texas ranch is threatened, Preston Sweet knows he and his siblings must do whatever it takes to save the land that has been in his family for generations—even marry. To everyone’s surprise, their neighbor Sarah Conroy offers to join forces with Preston to protect the ranch. What begins as a simple arrangement, soon takes unexpected turns. Can they withstand growing complications without losing the friendship they’ve always valued—or will this sweet beginning lead to a happily ever after?

Step into Honeysuckle, Texas, a charming small town where love, family, and ranching roots run deep. USA TODAY Bestselling Author Chris Keniston invites you to meet the Sweet family and their close-knit community filled with the lovable characters readers have come to expect. If you enjoy heartwarming romances brimming with laughter, love, and a touch of cowboy charm, you'll find it all in this unforgettable series. Prepare to be swept away by stories that will warm your heart and leave you smiling.
